title: Prototype Report
description:
The evidence package for gate G4 — the kill gate.

Its job is to make an honest kill possible. That means it must evaluate each kill criterion authored at strategy time with a MEASURED value, and it must carry playtest observations from someone who had not seen the game before. A report that only describes what was built cannot support a decision to stop.

The recommendation field is the producing role's view, not the verdict. The verdict is a decision-record.

url.description: A playable build a reviewer can open unaided.

iteration.description: Checked against title_strategy.max_prototype_iterations so ITERATE cannot become an unbounded polish loop.

proved.description: One entry per item in title_strategy.prototype_must_prove. The prototype exists to answer these; anything else built is scope that was not asked for.

kill_criteria_eval.description: Every criterion from title-strategy, with what was actually measured. Omitting one is how a kill gate quietly stops working.

playtest_sessions.description: At scale this is the vertical slice review, so the bar is 'a stranger played it', not 'the mechanic runs'.

player_context.description: First-time sessions are the ones that count. Internal sessions cannot tell you whether the game is understandable.

integration_status.description: The prototype must prove integration, not just gameplay. Deferring SDK and monetization wiring to production is how titles discover at release that the placement does not fit the loop.

scope_deltas.description: What was built that the plan did not call for, or planned and not built. Surfaced rather than absorbed silently.

rationale.description: Sunk cost is not a rationale. The question is whether we would start this today knowing what we now know.
